tasks.prompt: Write about your last weekend: where you were, what you did and how you felt. Explain why you liked it (or did not).
tasks.sample:
Last weekend I went to my grandmother's house in the village.

In the morning we walked to the river because the weather was lovely.

It was a wonderful weekend.

checklist.text: Я рассказал, где был и что делал

tasks.prompt: Write a short letter to a friend. Invite them to visit you.
tasks.sample:
Dear Anna,

Come and visit me in July! I look forward to seeing you.

instruction.text: Прочитайте задание и напишите свой текст.
